title: AI teacher: runnable examples and local console
summary: Add an editable JavaScript and Windows PowerShell lab with real results, plus teaching focused on why each step works.

changes.detail: Local opt-in owner-authenticated console for standalone Node.js JavaScript and Windows PowerShell; manual review/run, output/errors/timing, cancellation and execution limits.
Teacher explains concrete examples, expected versus actual output, line-by-line reasons and prediction exercises. Supported code blocks open an editable lab; result explanation prepares a chat draft.

validation.name: Implementation checks
validation.detail: Pending typecheck, focused lint, runtime/security tests and history checks. No production deployment or native terminal support.
